title: Reading what your agent changed
summary: Agents are eager: asked to fix a typo, one may also raise a setting and delete a test, then report 'Fixed the typo.' Drake reads the diff, not the summary. Start with git diff --stat, ask 'did I ask for this?' for each file, and read the full diff where the answer is no. I can run a scratch repository where two agents get the same request and a small Omega checker flags the files nobody asked for.
goal: See every change an agent made and catch the ones you never asked for.
key_steps: Run git diff --stat to list the changed files
Ask 'did I ask for this?' for each file
Read the full diff for any file you did not ask for
Send unrequested changes back with 'only change what I asked'

example.code:
note scope: lines "allow PATH" are what you asked to change, lines "changed PATH" are what changed
note exit 0 everything changed was asked for, 1 something else changed, 2 read error, 3 malformed line
text KW "allow \nchanged \nREFUSE malformed line \n\n: asked for\n: NOT ASKED FOR (read this part of the diff before accepting)\nIN SCOPE: every changed file was asked for\nOUT OF SCOPE: unrequested files=\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
fn same a ulong al ulong b ulong bl ulong to bool
if ne al bl
ret false
end
for j ulong al
if ne get inb add a j get inb add b j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn okline s ulong e ulong to bool
if pmat s e 0
ret true
end
ret pmat s e 1
end
fn asked n ulong a ulong al ulong to bool
s = ulong 0
o = klen 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
if pmat s e 0
if same add s o sub e add s o a al
ret true
end
end
s = add e 1
end
ret false
end
fn shape n ulong to ulong
s = ulong 0
ln = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
ln = add ln 1
if not okline s e
ret ln
end
s = add e 1
end
ret 0
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
ln = shape n
if ne ln 0
word 2
emitu ln
say 3
ret 3
end
bad = ulong 0
s = ulong 0
o = klen 1
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
if pmat s e 1
a = add s o
emiti a sub e a
if asked n a sub e a
say 4
else
say 5
bad = add bad 1
end
end
s = add e 1
end
if eq bad 0
say 6
ret 0
end
word 7
emitu bad
say 3
ret 1
end

common_mistake: Trusting the agent's summary instead of the diff. 'Fixed the typo' was true for both agents and only one should be merged. Fix: git diff --stat on every change, and read anything you did not ask for, especially a deleted test.
evidence_note: The example compiled and ran on a Linux ARM64 computer (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte, including a negative control. Rests on the recorded run in a throwaway git repository: agent A's change touched 3 files and scope.om exited 1 naming 2 unrequested files; agent B's touched 1 file and exited 0; a malformed line was refused with exit 3. NOT done: the agents are scripted, not real models.
